xiwen#dsh-xiwen is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.
